IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Thursday, October 8, 2026**

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is fat right now—66 calls, ~470 hands on the board, and Miller Electrical Contractors TN is running multiple data center pushes at QTS Fayetteville with 77 and 39 JWs respectively at **$42/hr**. Whitehead Electric's got 37 more hands needed for cable tray and feeder MC work at the same site. Book 1 is rolling fast here, and Atlanta's sticky heat beats winter freeze every time.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** is the sleeper: 48 calls, ~251 hands, and Gurtz Electric just reposted 69 JWs for Port Washington Data Center at **$60.00/hr**—that's JW wage plus **$10/hr base increase** on 60-hour weeks. Cupertino's got 30 more at the same rate, ASAP start. This is where the real money is if you can hold the pace.

**LU-26 Washington, DC** shows 52 calls, ~373 hands, all data center work across Northern VA. JE Richards has 107 JWs at Manassas on M-F (5)8s with 2hr OT plus Saturday 10hrs; another 16 at Mineral Springs; Dynalectric running Culpeper on mixed (3)8s and (3)12s schedules. No rates posted, but the volume is undeniable—this is pre-hire territory, which means they're already vetting.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** is tight: 7 calls but ~151 hands hungry. Cache Valley Electric's got 74 JWs at **$37.99/hr** plus **$15.00 per diem** over scale, running 5-10s and 2-8s day shift on a data center build. ArchKey Sachs is offering **$250/day per diem incentive** for Google West Memphis on 6/10s if you've got an Arkansas license.

**LU-237 Niagara Falls, NY** moved quick—76 JWs at Ferguson Electric on Lake Mariner Data Center at **$48.20/hr**, 1st Shift 6:30–5pm with per diem incentives live. State Group's got 4 more at the same rate.

**LU-1105 Newark, OH** is hot: Stoner Electric's Meta New Albany telecom project starts 6am Mon–Fri, with OT available. The Superior Group running two separate jobs—Project Cyrus 1 and CMH02 Conesville—on 4-10 rotations.

Data centers are absorbing all available hands coast-to-coast; infrastructure's finally moving money.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Thursday, October 8, 2026**

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** is the fat board right now — 57 calls burning for 72 hands and nobody's pretending this isn't Alaska money. Northern Powerline Constructors is pulling cable at JBER on **$57.44/hr** airfield lighting work. Carlos Tree Service and Wolf Creek Federal have specialty calls too, but the volume tells you the story: interior work, telecom, tree trimming, all stacked. Winter's coming and they're staffing hard.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** sits at 31 calls for 128 hands — tighter ratio but the money's talking. SERVICE ELECTRIC's got 17 Journeyman slots in Social Circle on **$56.80/hr**, plus **$10/hr over scale** and **$150/day per diem** if you hold the Quanta barehand cert. That's the real call. FAITH ELECTRIC's running statewide with **$49.80/hr** and hotels paid. Substation tech work at **$44.46/hr** fills the rest of the board.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** — nine calls, mostly inside wire but MICHELS POWER just posted 10 Journeyman Lineman slots in Midland on transmission at **$60.59/hr**, **$175 per diem**, running 6-12-hour days. That's the spike. Rosendin and Cache Valley Electric are splitting 40 inside JW calls between Claude and Llano on **$52.30/hr** with **40/day zone pay** and double-time OT. Data center and transmission work are both screaming.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** — only seven calls but every single one's a data center play at **$38.25/hr**. Cache Valley, ArchKey Sachs, Copperhead, Gephart — all inside wire, all the same rate, all shifting schedules (4/12s, 5-10s, nights). It's narrow but it's solid work.

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** and **LU-245 Toledo, OH** are the volume plays — 46 and 19 calls respectively, both heavy on distribution rebuild and transmission lattice work with New River Electric and MJ Electric anchoring the boards.

Data centers and transmission construction are vacuuming up hands faster than storm restoration; winter staffing is real.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Thursday, October 8, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is the board to watch — 18 calls with 61 hands needed across a serious pipeline. BCS Mechanical is running the Sego Project hard with 15 JM Pipefitters and 13 JM Plumbers on 4-10s (6:00 AM–4:30 PM, OT available) out of West Valley, all starting Aug 3. DSI's got 6 more JM Pipefitters on the QTS data center in Eagle Mountain, running a tighter 5-8s schedule with **$10.00** on this specific call. Book depth is solid here — this is volume work, not scarcity pricing.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** has 7 calls and 32 hands moving. The standout is Kiewit's CWI position at **$65/hr** with **$65 PD**, graveyard shift earning 15% differential — that's a night welder's payday if you've got the cert. Power Source Services wants combo welders with rigging experience on the JM Shafer station job in Fort Lupton. US Eng. Metalworks is building the fab shop bench with 14 fitters needing stainless experience.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** has only 1 call but it's work: 12 Journeyman positions on the Four Seasons towers in Henderson, starting late summer. OSHA 10/30 card mandatory. Thin board, but solid contractor pull.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** sits at 6 calls with 35 hands. Gem's fab shop is testing combo welders with incentive pay; Graham's got 8 Pipefitters on Cenovus Maintenance running 6-10s with spotty OT (must be current). Nooter adds 5 more Pipefitters on Cenovus fabrication work — **PD $125/day** — but DISA currency and no-beard policies apply.

**LU-213 St. John, NB** and **LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** are skeleton boards (2 and 1 calls respectively) but worth noting: Lake Utopia Paper is hiring F3/F4 stick welders and a JM Pipefitter; PMI's Fort Meade VA Hospital gig in South Dakota offers **PD $100/day** for UA-21 welders (OSHA 10 required).

Seasonality's flattening — industrial fab and data center work are pushing winter hiring across the Mountain West and Upper Midwest instead of summer peaks.
